what: A research gate rejected results a brief had explicitly allowed. A license check used only its own fixed, hard-coded allowlist, so worker-verified results the requesting brief explicitly permitted were moved to rejected anyway, and had to be re-admitted by hand.
rule: A gate driven by policy reads that policy from the request that actually made it, not only from a list baked into the tool.
fix: Enforcement: the gate now reads an explicit allowed-licenses line from the brief itself when present, falling back to the fixed list only when the brief names none. Regression coverage is in `tests/scout-125.test.mjs`.
